about.title: A private exchange for circular materials
about.intro: CMEP was born in Žilina with one idea: waste is just material that has not yet found a buyer. We connect companies that have surpluses with companies that can use them. No auction circus, no unnecessary phone calls, through one clear digital system.
about.focusText: Digital solutions for the circular economy

q1.a: CMEP (Circular Materials Exchange Platform) is a B2B exchange for circular materials. Companies trade and exchange secondary raw materials, production surpluses and by-products.

q2.a: For companies with surplus material (wood, metal, paper, plastics, bio waste) and companies looking for this material as input to their production.

q3.a: Every company that wants to trade must pass a company-ID verification. Verification ensures only serious companies are on the platform.

q4.a: Contacts (phone, email) stay hidden until companies agree. Communication happens through the internal platform chat.

q5.a: Registration and basic use of the platform are free. Premium features (listing priority, unlimited listings, API access) will be paid.

q6.a: Register, create a company, add your first listing. Other companies will contact you directly through the platform.
